correctness.rationale: For the ordered-pair twelve-vertex cubic graph, the inclusive graph-metric threshold one has f-vector (12,18,4) and exact mod-two boundary ranks (11,4); threshold two has (12,42,48,12) and ranks (11,31,12). The latter ranks achieve rational upper bounds from connectivity, the boundary relation and column counts, so rational homology dimensions are 3 in H1 at scale 1 and 5 in H2 at scale 2. Independently enumerated all S4 label permutations and their signed fixed-face Lefschetz counts, yielding characters (3,-1,-1,0,1) and (5,1,1,2,-1). Character inner products give sign-twisted standard and trivial+sign+standard; A4 invariants have rank two versus S4 rank one. Threshold >=3 is a simplex; interval endpoints are inclusive [1,2),[2,3). These are exact finite facts, not asymptotic numerical extrapolations.
